target_population.unit: deduplicated publisher payout entity, not a game, contributor, buyer or user account
target_population.eligibility: has at least one publicly available or valid historically released positive minimum-price game within the specified observation frame

estimation_contract.median_rule: sort_one_publisher_measure_per_eligible_entity_including_zero_receipt_publishers; use central value(s) under predeclared even_N convention
estimation_contract.quantile_rule: disclose p10 p25 p50 p75 p90 rank_method and right_censoring; do not interpolate from selected successful developers
estimation_contract.games_to_publishers: deduplicate account and corporate payout entities with valid authorization before aggregation

identification_argument: Existing records constrain a handful of reported game or creator cash figures and several nontransaction indicators.
Unobserved eligible publishers can legitimately have zero positive-price orders or a large number of them; both possibilities produce the same reported public data.
Without the eligible publisher denominator and an observed or probability-weighted receipt for all relevant entities, the total and sorted distribution are not identified.
The survey's 63% zero overall gamedev income cannot be multiplied by public paid-game catalog counts because the respondents are not the defined itch.io seller population.
Zero public ratings and zero sales are different unobserved statuses, so replacing missing receipts with zeros would bias the median.
Sample-based rates from creator posts can be affected by selection on success and publication willingness; no inclusion weights are available.
No imputation from website visits, browser plays or developer genre self-tags identifies seller revenue.

The profile:games endpoint lists an authorized user's uploaded or editable games and example lifetime summary fields. It does not produce a time-matched, refunded-order and payout-entity population frame; editor access does not prove owner proceeds.
scope_limitations: Review covers the dated sources in Mercata and the official policy consulted through October 27, 2026; absence of usable evidence here does not assert that no private dataset exists.
An unknown statistic is not a measured zero, and an incomplete sample does not make its biased mean representative.
First-game earnings, all-time balances, seller salaries, donation proceeds, game gross and platform GMV are incompatible unless strictly reconciled.
Private identities, tax IDs, buyer details and payout records are neither necessary to publish nor authorized for scraping in this research.
Task acceptance is completeness of evidence search and explicit unknown result, not an assertion of a discovered numerical mean or median.
The newly confirmed owner-profile endpoint is documented but not called; its public JSON example must not be treated as a live 2026 merchant transaction observation.
